title: DynamicExponentialLoad
description: Parameters of 2-states of a generic dynamic load model based on "Voltage stability analysis using generic dynamic load models." It has no bus of its own: exactly one static injection device, with the same name, names it in its `dynamic_injector` property, and that device supplies the rest of its data.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the dynamic injection. Must equal the name of the static injection device that names it in `dynamic_injector`.

T_p.description: Active Power Time Constant. Units: s.

T_q.description: Reactive Power Time Constant. Units: s.

base_power.description: Base power for the per-unit parameters of this model. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the static injection device that names this model. Units: MVA.
